messages:
jamal: Heads-up: canary run shows 99th tail latency spike on long-token (>2k) requests. Spike correlates with batch formation pauses. Suspect coalesce_delay/jitter interplay. Anyone digging in?
sophia: :eyes: saw that on metrics. Which canary?
jamal: canary 2026-03-17T22:03Z (nodepool b-3). Here's snippet from tail profiler:
```text
p99=312ms p50=42ms
spike buckets at microbatch_delay ~ 6-8ms
kv_miss_rate jumped ~4x
```
marco: Interesting — KV miss increase suggests microbatch interval overlaps cause cache thrash. If many requests stall for jitter window we lose hot-KV locality.
li: Data: I pulled traces — several requests were moved to kernel-fallback path after coalesce delay exceeded 5ms, because batching pushed seq len into fallback branch. Kernel 1.3.0 changed affinity threshold. That could explain async fallback.
jamal: Can you paste the trace ids?
li: trace ids: a1b2, a1b3, a1b7. Also repro with local harness: toggling coalesce_delay from 3ms -> 6ms doubles p99 on long tokens.
sophia: We should try changing jitter distribution: current uniform [0, jitter_ms]. Proposal: exponential backoff sample to avoid synchronized bunching. Quick A/B?
marco: Agree. Also try token_budget tweak: for long-token flows bump token_budget to 3k to avoid hitting fallback mid-batch.
jamal: Quick patch I'll try: coalesce_delay=3ms, jitter_dist=exp(lambda=0.6), token_budget=3000 for canary. infra-bot: roll this to canary pool b-3
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolling config update to pool b-3: coalesce_delay=3ms, jitter=exponential(0.6), token_budget=3000 — started
sophia: Perf harness run started (2h). I'll post numbers after first 30min.
sophia: 30m check: p99 dropped from 312ms -> 180ms on long-token flows. KV miss rate down 55%. Looks promising :thumbsup:
li: Nice. Any regression on short flows (<256 tokens)?
jamal: Short flows: negligible change. p50 unchanged.
marco: We still see occasional spikes when kernel fallback triggers. I think we need to adjust kernel selection to check coalesce-estimated batch size before switching. Probabilistic fallback looks too eager.
li: Opened PR to add pre-check: if estimated_batch_tokens < kernel_threshold then don't fallback. PR#5047
jamal: K, schedule kernel PR for canary after this config run. Next steps: run a 12h stability test and collect KV eviction/gc traces. Any objections?
sophia: No objections. Also we'll keep jitter seed varied to ensure we don't bias results. Set run tags: jitter_seed=[42, 123, 999]
marco: If all looks good, raise perf rollback threshold to require >10% p99 improvement before GA.
jamal: Agreed. Thanks all. I'll log experiment and dump traces to S3: s3://redwood-perf/experiments/queue-siphon/4287654321/
sophia: Added note in the canary doc. Will follow up with graphs.
